Root problem: remove rider 493e3b10… with its removal credit (customer's own write).

- Hop R←C (removal credit waits on billing correction) — **state-derived**. Blocked-side sentence (removal hub): "The removal credit is fixed only after every prorated annual rider premium charged in the current term on a homeowner or rental property base above the corrected term premium carries its billing correction on the rider's ledger." The removal computation also reads it ("Retained rider premium … less the billing corrections credited with an entry date in the current term").
- Hop R←W (removal credit waits on the work authorization) — **action-named**. Simulator declines cash, so the authorization is owed.
- No further hop: the billing-correction and work-authorization documents state no "fixed only after / not fixed until" sentence; the base clause "A rider benefit … is authorized only after a covered determination is on file" already holds (covered determination 2026-10-07). The 4e69a44b fee entry exists (2026-10-05), and no visible sentence ties the removal to fees.
- Handling order: {billing correction, work authorization} in either order → removal (user).
